content: It is recommended that healthcare providers conduct routine screenings for social determinants of health (SDOH) during clinical encounters. This practice aims to identify patients who may require additional support in managing their health. Research has shown that many patients may not voluntarily disclose challenges such as financial hardships or difficulties related to affording medications unless they are directly asked about these issues. Therefore, healthcare professionals are encouraged to proactively inquire about these factors to better address the needs of their patients.
